network.proxyDesc: System proxy for typical desktop apps.
network.tunDesc: Full system traffic. May require elevated privileges.
network.modeReconnectHint: Picking the other mode reconnects to the same server in it.
network.disconnectHintError: Wait for the connection to finish before changing connection mode.
network.tunUnavailable: TUN mode is not supported on this operating system.
network.tunUnsupportedDarwin: TUN mode is currently supported only on Windows and Linux by the bundled Xray core.
network.tunElevated_win32: TUN mode needs Administrator rights. Connect in TUN mode and approve the UAC prompt (or run UltimaVLESS as Administrator).
network.tunElevated: TUN mode needs elevated privileges. Install a PolicyKit agent (pkexec) so UltimaVLESS can request them when you connect, or run UltimaVLESS as root.
network.tunDegradedLinux: Linux TUN routing currently relies on Xray auto-route behavior rather than explicit OS-level route teardown.
network.tunBlockDnsLeaksHint: Without it Windows also sends DNS queries to the DNS servers of your other adapters, such as the router, past the tunnel. When on, Xray adds Windows Filtering Platform filters so DNS of every program except Xray (port 53, and DNS over TLS and QUIC on port 853) goes only through TUN. This breaks a local DNS resolver of other programs (127.0.0.1:53), the DNS of another VPN on its own adapter, virtual machines that resolve names through the host NAT, and signing in to captive portals (hotel or airport Wi-Fi).
network.windowsTunApplyHint: Save performance settings and reconnect in TUN mode for the change to take effect.
network.tunAdapterHint: The adapter Xray sends tunnel traffic through. Automatic follows the Windows default route; pick one by hand if TUN only worked after you disabled other adapters.
network.tunAdapterMissingWarning: Adapter "{{name}}" is not connected right now. TUN will not connect until it is back — or switch to Automatic.
network.tunAdapterNoGatewayWarning: Adapter "{{name}}" has no default gateway, so TUN cannot reach the server through it.
network.performanceHint: Changes take effect on the next connection.
network.advancedHint: Low-level Xray parameters. The defaults suit most servers.
network.performanceLocked: Disconnect the VPN to change performance settings.
network.muxEnabledHint: Multiplex TCP connections. Reduces latency but may lower throughput for downloads.
network.xhttpMaxConnectionsHint: Parallel TCP links for XHTTP (xmux.maxConnections, 1–16). Default 3 matches Xray 26.7.28+; raise if the server feels starved.
network.remoteDnsHint: Resolvers used by Xray (no localhost). In TUN mode, OS DNS on port 53 is hijacked into these servers via the proxy. Full leak protection requires TUN mode.
network.tunMtuHint: If sites open in proxy mode but not in TUN on a slow server, lower this. Default 1400 leaves room for VPN headers so packets are not dropped. 1280 is safer on a bad line; 1500 is native ethernet and may stall.
network.tunDnsQueryStrategyHint: TUN only — proxy always uses IPv4. IPv4-only is the default so pages open instead of hanging ~10s while Windows waits for IPv6. Switch to IPv4 and IPv6 or Follow the OS only if you need IPv6 sites through the tunnel.
network.tunDnsUseIPv4Desc: Recommended. Pages open faster in TUN
network.tunDnsUseIPDesc: When IPv6 sites must go through TUN
network.xudpProxyUDP443Hint: How to handle QUIC traffic through the proxy.
network.tcpFastOpenHint: Send data in the SYN packet to reduce connection latency.
network.sniffingRouteOnlyHint: Use sniffing results only for routing, don't override destination.
network.pingMethodHint: Real delay starts a short-lived Xray for each server and times an HTTP request through it, like v2rayN. It catches servers that answer but pass no traffic, and is slower on large lists.
network.logLevelHint: Xray core verbosity. Use 'debug' for troubleshooting.
network.fingerprintHint: Default browser fingerprint for anti-detection. Per-server value takes priority.
network.blockAdsHint: Block known ad domains via geosite:category-ads-all.
network.blockBittorrentHint: Prevent BitTorrent traffic through the proxy.
network.domainStrategyHint: DNS resolution strategy for routing rules.
network.splitTunnelHint: Sites and addresses that go straight out through your normal connection instead of the VPN. A host also covers its subdomains.
network.splitTunnelEmpty: Nothing excluded: all traffic goes through the VPN.
network.splitTunnelDnsNote: Site rules match the domain from TLS/HTTP sniffing; add an IP or CIDR for traffic that cannot be sniffed. DNS queries stay inside the tunnel.
network.routingRulesHint: Choose what goes through the VPN and what goes straight out. Changes take effect on the next connection.
network.routingLocked: Disconnect the VPN to change routing rules.
network.routingModeAllDesc: Except exclusions and apps that bypass the VPN.
network.routingModeSitesDesc: Sites from the list go through the VPN, everything else goes direct.
network.routingModeAppsDesc: Chosen programs go through the VPN, everything else goes direct.
network.routingProxySitesHint: A domain also covers its subdomains. IPs, CIDR blocks and geosite:/geoip: lists work too.
network.routingProxySitesEmpty: The list is empty: all traffic goes direct.
network.routingProxyAppsHint: All connections of these programs go through the VPN, except the local network and excluded sites.
network.routingProxyAppsEmpty: The list is empty: all traffic goes direct.
network.routingDirectAppsHint: These programs always use your normal connection, in every mode.
network.routingAppsPlaceholder: Search programs or type a name
network.routingAppsNoMatches: No running program matches. Press Enter to add the name as typed.
network.routingAppsNoRunning: No running programs found — type a name or choose a file.
network.routingAppsCaseNote: Apps are matched by executable name, case-sensitively — pick a running program from the list or choose the file. If a program uses helper processes (e.g. steamwebhelper.exe), add each of them.
network.routingAppsProxyNote: In proxy mode app rules only apply to programs that use the system proxy. Switch to TUN mode to route every program.
network.routingPriority: Priority, first match wins: ad and BitTorrent blocking → apps that bypass the VPN → sites and addresses (a more specific entry wins: music.example.com beats example.com; on a tie the exclusion wins) → local network, direct → apps through VPN → the selected mode.
